description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle Database data source to Azure Database for PostgreSQL and configure Managed Identity authentication. Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL driver, update Spring datasource configuration, convert Hibernate dialect, and adapt any Oracle-specific SQL syntax (including BLOB to bytea for photo data storage).
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC driver, OracleDialect, and BLOB data types. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service on Azure, eliminating the need for self-managed Oracle infrastructure.
tasks.requirements: Replace the Oracle JDBC data source, driver, and dialect with PostgreSQL equivalents; convert Oracle BLOB photo storage to PostgreSQL bytea and adapt Oracle-specific SQL and schema definitions to PostgreSQL. Configure the Spring datasource to connect to Azure Database for PostgreSQL and authenticate using Managed Identity instead of plaintext credentials.
